text: I have been charged twice this month for the same Pro subscription and I want a full refund NOW. This is the second time your billing has taken money it should not have. Refund both charges today or I am disputing them with my bank.

Your terms say annual plans can be cancelled but support refused to refund the remaining eight months. I have forwarded the entire thread to my solicitor and we will be filing a claim in small claims court unless this is resolved in writing within 7 days.

My bank statement shows two separate CloudNote charges for the same amount on the 3rd and the 4th. In the app I only see one invoice for this period. Is the second one going to disappear on its own or has something gone wrong?
Got an email saying my payment failed. My card expired last week and I have already added the new one. Has my plan been cancelled? Will I lose the notebooks I have over the free limit?

i pay monthly at the moment. if i switch to the yearly plan today do i get charged the whole year straight away or does it wait until my current month finishes? also do i lose the days i already paid for
Our finance team needs the invoices to show our company name and GST number. The last three invoices only have my personal email. Can these be reissued with the correct tax details on them?
How do I cancel? I want to stop being billed but I do not want to lose access immediately because I still need to get my notes out before the end of the month.

An entire notebook with about 400 notes from the last two years is GONE. Not in trash, not in history, nothing. This is years of client work and I need it back. I have already checked on my laptop and my phone and it is missing on both.
Notes I write on my phone are not showing up on my desktop app. Desktop shows a red dot next to sync. I am signed in on my laptop, my phone and my work machine. Free plan.
Why do I keep getting notes called Conflicted copy? I now have three versions of the same meeting note and I cannot tell which one is the real one. Is it deleting my edits?
Desktop app on Windows crashes about two seconds after I open it. Reinstalling did not help. It worked fine until Tuesday. The web version is fine so I do not think my account is the problem.
Trying to attach a 60 MB video to a note and it fails every time with no error message. I am on the free plan. Smaller images attach without any trouble.
Search is useless right now. I know I have a note with the word invoice in it because I am looking at it, but searching invoice returns nothing at all. Started a couple of days ago.
I edited notes on the train with no signal and when I got back online none of the changes were there. I did sign out at some point during the journey. Pro plan.

There is a sign-in on my account from a device in another country that is definitely not mine, and someone has been reading a notebook with confidential HR files in it. I need to know exactly what was accessed and when. Please treat this as a security incident.

Under GDPR Article 17 I am formally requesting erasure of my personal data and all of my notes from CloudNote and from your backups. Please confirm in writing once this has been completed and tell me your retention period for backups.
The password reset email never arrives. I have tried four times, checked spam, and the address is definitely the one I signed up with. Is there something wrong with the reset system?
New phone, old phone wiped, and my authenticator app went with it. I cannot get past the two-factor prompt. I think I saved the backup codes somewhere when I set this up. What are my options?
I am leaving my job so I need to move my CloudNote account off my work email onto my personal one without losing any of my notes. How do I do that?

This is the most useless garbage app I have ever paid for and whoever built this export feature is clearly an idiot. Absolute joke of a product. Fix it or refund me, I do not care which, but stop wasting my time with your stupid help articles.
I am moving to a different notes app and want everything out in a format that keeps my tags. Which export option should I pick, and how long does it take for a workspace with a few thousand notes?
Is there a way to make a standard layout for my weekly review so I do not rebuild the same headings every Monday? Ideally it would fill in the date on its own.
The summarize button does nothing on my account. A colleague on the same team can use it on her notes. Is this a plan thing or has an admin switched it off?
I shared a notebook with a contractor and I only want them to see two notes in it, not the whole thing. I also do not want them editing anything. What permission should I use?
I overwrote a note this morning with the wrong content. Can I get back what it said yesterday, and how far back does that go on the Pro plan?
